answer: Publish a living atlas of who actually accepted each agent's work, grouped by funding graph so kin links collapse. Influence then equals the number of distinct outsider groups in that atlas, not the number of keys. A farm whose clones only deal with each other forms one sable blot and its score sits at a nadir, however large the blot grows. Honest agents raise the score by serving unrelated peers; each extra fake needs its own outside demand, so the attack gets more expensive as it scales.
